properties.name: MEASURED on flo2.io 2026-10-11 (0.83.0): compare_designs flo2 vs reflow2 by graph_id answers in 5.2–5.8 s, but with budget_chars 4000 its reply is 1,421,523 characters — the budget trims prose and edges_added, and keeps every diverging id in design.added/removed and edges_removed at full length; compose_and_analyse on the same pair takes 18.3–18.7 s and 2.1 MB
properties.source: api.flo2.io/g/1a97fc1f1de4d5d2/mcp, 2026-10-11 ~19:15 UTC, scratchpad measure_view.py and inspect_view.py
properties.statement:
Layer 1c, through api.flo2.io with the owner's key, 3 rounds each. compare_designs {other_graph_id: reflow2, budget_chars: 4000} on flo2's design: 5.83, 5.20, 5.69 s; reply 3.78 MB on the wire. Its budget block says applied: true, full_chars 7,302,525, reply_chars 1,421,523, fields_trimmed 10,124, and "Every diverging node id and every count is still here"; edges_removed alone is 608,049 chars and design.added 340,314. So the budget's floor — every id kept — is far above any client's limit when the two designs are unrelated (flo2 and reflow2 share almost nothing), and the reply the budget note itself says a client refuses is still sent. compose_and_analyse {other_graph_id: reflow2}: 18.51, 18.73, 18.33 s; 2.09 MB. Neither was refused; the readable set admitted reflow2 for the owner. Not a view defect: compare_designs was built for versions of one design, where the diff is small; by graph_id any readable design can be named, so the worst case is now one call away. Fix direction (not built): when the ids alone exceed the budget, page them (offset/limit per list) or answer counts plus the first N ids per list with a way to fetch the rest, instead of keeping all. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq

FIXED 2026-10-12 on commit 59553c771 (chg:a-bounded-reply-shortens-every-list-by-its-cost-and-compare-designs-pages-one-2026-10-12). Cause, confirmed by unit tests failing first: the budget's list sampler shortened only the one list longest by element count and never counted its own budget block, so the other id lists stayed whole. Now every list gives by the characters it costs until the reply fits, and compare_designs pages one list with `list` + `offset`. Measured through --call: budget 3,000 on a 7,969-char diff gives 2,962 chars with design.added 10 of 80 and edges_added 9 of 40, and paging reproduces the full list in order. Not yet re-measured on flo2.io's flo2-vs-reflow2 pair (needs a release). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq

RE-MEASURED LIVE 2026-10-12 on flo2.io after the upgrade to 0.83.2, the same pair (flo2's design against reflow2 by graph id, budget_chars 4000): 8.4 s, budget.reply_chars 3,934, eight lists named in lists_shortened (design.added 2 of 3,022, edges_added 2 of 50,976 ...). Paging design.added with list + offset gave 17 of 3,022 with next_offset 17. As received the reply was 4,632 characters: flo2 adds a 641-character the_person_you_are_talking_to block outside the engine's budget, recorded on flo2's side (fact:the-person-block-is-added-after-the-engines-budget-so-a-bounded-reply-arrives-over-it-2026-10-12). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
